tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas drug pa'i tshig don bzhugs/

gsum pa thob bya 'gog lam gyi bden pa gtan la dbab pa la/ lam gyi rnam gzhag /rten gang zag gi rnam gzhag /lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ lam gyi ngo bo/ dmigs pa/ sgom tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bden pa mthong ba dang bsgoms pa las/ /nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa/ /sgom pa'i lam ni rnam gnyis te/ /mthong ba zhes bya zag pa med/ /ces byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa la gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ bden pa mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam dang*/ rtogs zin bsgoms par byas pa'i lam gnyis kyis nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa'i lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sgom pa'i lam ni chos can/ khyod la'ang rnam pa gnyis yod de/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas 'jig rten ba'i zag bcas sgom lam dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zag med sgom lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mthong ba zhes bya ba'i lam chos can/ khyod zag med 'das lam kho na yin te/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/mthong lam rjes thob ye shes yod zer na/ de med par thal/ skad cig ma bcu drug ni mnyam gzhag thun gcig yin par bshad cing*/ de'i bcu drug pa sgom lam nyid yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/zag med 'phags lam la mnyam gzhag gis khyab zer na/ 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rjes thob ye shes su gyur pa'i mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ lam bden yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ kha cigazag bcas sgom lam de sgom lam yin zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de zag med 'phags lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zag bcas sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/sdug bden yin na/ sdug bsngal yin pas khyab zer na/ zag bcas kyi tshor pa bde ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ zag bcas kyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ bde ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ so skye'i rgyud la bde ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des dge ba byas pa'i rnam smin bde ba myong ba yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig/phyi rol pa'i rgyud la lam yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la sgom lam yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la 'jig rten pa'i zag bcas sgom lam yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ lam zhugs kyi phyi rol pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bden bzhi dang*/ bden gnyis bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ zag bcas rnams sdug bden du bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden pa dag ni bzhir bshad do/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung de bzhin du/ /'gog dang lam ste de ltar na/ /de dag ji ltar mngon rtogs rim/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir bden pa dag ni chos can/ khyod la bzhir bshad de/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ kun 'byung gi bden pa/ de bzhin du 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ lam gyi bden pa ste de ltar na bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i go rim de ltar bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de dag bden bzhi'i yul can mngon rtogs skye ba'i rim pa ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i go rim bzhin du mdo las kyang bshad pa yin te/ mdo las/ dge slong dag 'di sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyis rim pa de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yid 'ong yid du mi 'ong dang*/ /de las zag bcas gzhan rnams nyid/ /sdug bsngal nyid gsum ldan pa'i phyir/ /ci rigs ma lus sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes byung*/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba yid du 'ong ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba ste mi bde ba'am sdug bsngal dang gnyis po de las gzhan pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms rnams gsum dang*/ mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po ma lus pa chos can/ sdug bsngal zhes mdo las bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

sdug bsngal nyid gsum po ci rigs dang ldan zhing 'brel pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod kyi/ sdug bsngal kho na yin pa'i sgo nas bshad pa ma yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhes byung*/ kun rdzob bden pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gang la bcom pa'am blo yis chos gzhan so sor bsal ba na der 'dzin gyi blo mi 'jug pa'i chos de de'i mtshan nyid dang*/ kun rdzob tu grub tshad gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum pa dang*/ bum nang gi chu bzhin te/ bum pa ni tho bas bcom pa na bum pa'i blo 'dor/ bum chu yang chu de'i kha dog dri ro reg bya so sor bsal ba na chur 'dzin pa'i blo 'dor ba'i phyir ro/ /de gnyis chos can/ kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya ste/ 'dir kun rdzob ni tha snyad pa'i shes pa 'khrul ma 'khrul ci rigs la byed pa yin la/ khyod de'i ngo bor bden pas kun rdzob bden pa zhes bzhag pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob tu grub tshad yod de/ tha snyad du yod pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa chos can khyod kyis mtshan nyid la yod de/ snga ma las gzhan bcom bsal gang rung gis der 'dzin pa'i blo mi 'dor ba'i chos de de yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes sogs sems sems byung rang rkya ba rnams chos can/ don dam bden pa yin te/ bcom gzhig byas kyang gzugs tshor sogs kyi blo mi 'dor ba'i phyir/ gzugs tshor sogs chos can/ don dam bden pa zhes bya ste/ don dam pa ni 'phags pa'i ye shes yin la/ de'i yul gyi don du yod cing bden pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/gsum pa lam sgom tshul la/ lam la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang*/ lam sgom tshul gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/

tshul gnas thob dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /thos sogs las byung blo rnams ni/ /ming dag gnyis ka don yul can/ /ces byung*/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam chos can/ khyod la 'jug tshul gyi khyad par bzhi yod de/ dang po kho nar tshul khrims la gnas dgos/ de nas bden pa mthong ba dang mthun pa'i thos pa dang*/ de nas de'i don la bsam pa dang ldan pa dang*/ de nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ thos pa dang sogs pas bsam pa dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i blo rnams ni chos can/ so so'i ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ gzhung de'i ming tsam la dmigs pa'i shes rab de thos byung gi shes rab dang*/ de'i ming dang don gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i shes rab de bsam byung gi shes rab dang*/ don kho na la dmigs pas rab tu phyi ba'i yul can gyi shes rab de bsgoms byung gi shes rab tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ de ni bye smra'i lugs yin la/ slob dpon rang lugs yod de/ yid ches pa'i lung tshad ma las dang por skyes pa'i shes rab de thos byung dang*/ de nas brtags shing dpyad pa las byung ba'i shes rab de bsam byung dang*/ ting nge 'dzin zhi gnas yan chad las skyes pa'i shes rab de bsgoms byung du bzhed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ lam sgom pa'i gang zag /sgom pa'i tshul dang gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag gi ngo bo mi mthun phyogs dang bcas pa/ de la ldan pa'i yon tan/ de rigs su 'jog tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bsring gnyis dang ldan chog shes dang*/ /'dod chen can la ma yin no/ /rnyed la yang sred chog mi shes/ /ma rnyed la 'dod 'dod chen can/ /zhes byung*/ /sgom la brtson pa'i gang zag chos can/ khyod kyis sgom pa rdzogs pa'i thabs gnyis yod de/ 'du 'dzin thag bsring nas gcig pur gnas pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i rnam rtog thag bsring ba gnyis dang ldan na rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

de gnyis 'dod chung chog shes dang ldan pa la sla zhing*/ gang zag gang la dka' ba yod de/ 'dod chen can la dka' zhing sla ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ mngon pa ba na re/ chog mi shes pa dang 'dod chen can gy-i ngo bo yod de/ rnyed pa gang grub kyis mi chog par bzang po yang yang 'dod cing sred pa ni chog mi shes pa dang*/ ma rnyed pa ngag la gdung zhing 'dod pa che ba ni 'dod chen can yin pa'i phyir zer/ slob dpon na re/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ bzang po dang mang po ma rnyed na yid mi bde ba ni chog mi shes pa dang*/ de lta bu ma rnyed pas de la 'dod zhen che ba ni 'dod chen can yin par gsung*/ gnyis pa ni/ bzlog pa de yi gnyen po dag/de gnyis khams gsum gtogs dri med/ /ces byung*/ de las bzlog pa 'dod chung chog shes dag chos can/ bzlog zla de yi gnyen po yin te/ de gnyis dngos su 'joms byed yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ khams gsum du gtogs pa re dang dri med 'phags lam gyis bsdus pa re yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rigs su 'jog tshul ni/ ma chags 'phags rigs de dag las/ /gsum ni chog shes bdag nyid do/ /gsum gyis tshul bstan tha ma'i las/ /bdag gi bdag 'dzin dngos 'dod pa/ /de yi dus dang gtan zhi'i phyir/ /zhes byung*/ 'dod chung chog shes gnyis chos can/ /ma chags pa yin te/ chags pa'i 'gal zla ste gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ ma chags pa chos can/ 'phags pa'i rigs yin te/ 'phags pa dang de'i chos rnams skye ba'i gzhi yin pas na rigs zhes bya ba'i phyir chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang*/ de bzhin du bsod snyoms dang*/ gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang*/ spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba'i 'phags rigs bzhi mdo las gsungs pa de dag las dang po gsum ni chos can/ ma chags pa yin te/ 'dod chung chog shes pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyis ni 'phags pa'i rigs kyi tshul bsdus la/

tha ma spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba chos can/ khyod kyi byed las yod de/ khyod kyis bdag gir 'dzin pa dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dngos po 'dod pa de yi dus gnyis ka dang bcas gtan tu zhi bar byed la/ dang po gsum gyis ni chos gos sogs kyi dngos po la bdag gir 'dzin pa'i 'dod pa nyid zhi bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgom tshul dngos la/ zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la 'jug pa mi sdug dang*/ /dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung dran pa yi/ /'dod chags rnam rtog lhag rnams so/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ spyi don gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar rigs dang ldan pas/ bsgom pa de la 'jug tshul yod de/ 'dod chags shas che bas mi sdug pa sgom pa la 'jug /rnam rtog shas lhag par che ba rnams kyis ni/ dbugs tshur rngub pa dang phyir 'byung ba dran pa sgom par byed pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thar par bgrod pa'i gshegs shul gyi mngon rtogs de/ thar lam gyi mtshan nyid dang sgra bshad kyang yin la/ de la ni rten gyi sgo nas ni nyan rang sogs kyi lam gsum/ de re re la'ang tshogs lam sogs lnga lnga yod cing*/ 'dir 'khor dang bcas na phung po lnga pa can no/ /tshogs lam la ni thos byung dang bsam sbyor shugs che yang*/ der ma nges te/ tshogs lam skad cig tha ma ni bsgom byung gtso che ba'i phyir/ der thal/ der zhi gnas gtso che ba'i phyir/ sbyor lam sogs gsum la ni bsgom byung gtso che yang thos bsam med pa ni min te/ 'phags pa slob pa thos bsam la'ang 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/ sgom tshul ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ mi sdug pa sgom tshul dang*/ dbugs rngub 'byung dran pa sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ de sgom tshul dang*/ de'i rnam gzhag gnyis dang po ni/ keng rus chags bcas thams cad la/ /rus pa rgya mtsho'i bar du ni/

/spro zhing sdud pa las dang po/ /rkang rus nas ni thod phyed bar/ /btang bas sbyang pa byas par bshad/ /smin ma'i bar du sems 'dzin pas/ /yid la byed pa rdzogs pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ khyod sgom pa'i yul gyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ rnam par bsngos pa dang*/ rnam par zos pa'am 'thor ba dang*/ rnam par 'bus gzhig pa dang*/ ro la dmigs nas sgom pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi gang gi gnyen por sgom pa'i tshul yod de/ kha dog dang dbyibs dang reg bya dang bsnyen bkur la chags pa'i gnyen por sgom par byed pa'i phyir/ gang gis sgom pa yod de/ chags bcas thams cad kyis bsgom par byar rung ba'i phyir/ sgom pa de chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ rang gi rkang pa'i mthe bong ngam dpral ba'i rus pa zag nas lhung ba'i rjes kyi rus pa keng rus ltar dkar lhag ger yod par mos shing*/ de nas de bzhin du lus kyi rus pa thams cad dang*/ gtsug lag khang lta bu nas phyi'i rgya mtsho'i bar du keng rus kyis khyab par spro zhing*/ sdud pa'i tshe tshur rim gyis bsdus nas rang nyid gcig pu'i lus keng rus su mos par byed pa ni las dang po pa'i sgom tshul dang*/ rkang rus bor nas lhag mar mos shing de bzhin du thod pa'i phyed ka btang ste phyed ka gzhan sgom pa ni yongs su sbyang bar byas pa'i sgom tshul du bshad/ thod pa'i phyed sgom pa yang bor nas smin ma'i bar tsam keng rus su sems 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa ni/ mi sdug pa'i yid la byed pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ mi sdug mi chags sa bcu dang*/ dmigs pa 'dod snang mis skyed do/ /zhes byung*/ mi sdug bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ rang bzhin dang sems rten dang dmigs pa dang lus rten bcas bzhi yod de/ ngo bo ma chags pa dang*/ sems rten bsam gtan bzhi dang de'i nyer bsdogs bzhi dang bsam gtan khyad par can dang 'dod sems te sa bcu dang*/

dmigs pa kha phyir bltas 'dod pa'i snang ba kha dog sogs la dmigs pa dang*/ rten gling gsum gyi mis skyed par byed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis mi sdug pa sgom tshul mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa ni gzugs la dmigs pa yin la/ gzugs med kyis gzugs la mi dmigs pa'i phyir/gsum pa dbugs rngub 'byung dran pa sgom pa la/ de'i rnam gzhag dang*/ sgom tshul drug bshad pa dang*/ de'i yul bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung dran pa ni/ /shes rab sa lnga spyod yul rlung*/ / 'dod rten phyi pa'i ma yin no/ /zhes byung*/ dbugs ni rlung yin la/ rngub pa nang du 'jug pa dang*/ 'byung ba phyir 'byung ba ste de ltar dran pa ni chos can/ khyad par drug dang ldan te/ ngo bo shes rab dang*/ sems rten bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs gsum dang bsam gtan khyad par can dang 'dod pa'i sa lnga dang*/ spyo yul lam dmigs pa rlung dang*/ lus rten 'dod pa dang*/ thob tshul sbyor byung dang*/ yid byed chags bral byed pa'i tshul gyis byed pa'i phyir/ phyi rol pas 'di sgom pa min te/ nang pa kho na'i yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgom tshul drug gi khyad par ni/ bgrang ba la sogs rnam pa drug /ces byung*/ dbugs rngub 'byung chos can/ sgom tshul khyad par drug dang ldan te/ bgrang ba dang la sogs pas rjes 'gro dang*/ 'jog pa dang*/ nyer rtog dang*/ yongs su sgyur ba dang*/ yongs dag dang rnam pa drug yod pa'i phyir/ de dag gi khyad par yod de/ bgrang ba ni phyi nang du rgyu ba'i grangs la sems gtod pa dang*/ rjes 'gro ni 'byung rngub kyi 'gros gnas pa la de gtong de nas 'jog pa ni rlung sna rtse nas rkang pa'i bar du gnas pa la dang*/ nye bar rtog pa ni 'byung bzhi'i rlung dang phung po lngar so sor brtags nas dang*/ yongs sgyur ni rlung la dmigs nas blo bsgyur te dran pa nyer gzhag sogs gong nas gong du zhi lhag gnyis kyis sgom pa dang*/

yod sa dag ni de ltar bsgoms pas mthong sgom gyi dri ma dag pa mi slob pa'i lam la 'jug pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung gang las lus/ /sems can zhes bya ma zin pa'o/ /rgyu mthun las byung 'og ma yi/ /yid kyis de gnyis mi rtogs so/ /zhes byung*/ dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung pa gnyis chos can/ sa lus gang gang du gtogs pa der gtogs te/ lus kyi phyogs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan te/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi yin pas sems can zhes bya ba dang*/ dbang pos ma zin pa dang*/ rgyu mthun snga ma las byung ba dang*/ sa 'og ma spyod lam pa dang sprul pa'i yid kyis mi rtogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul la/ thog mar dran pa nyer gzhag/de nas drod sogs bzhi/ de nas bden pa mngon rtogs bcu drug sgom tshul dang gsum/ dang po la spyir bstan pa dang*/ chos dran pa nyer gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zhi gnas grub par gyur pa yis/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bsgom par bya/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams la/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs brtags pas/ /shes rab thos sogs las byung ba/ /gzhan ni 'brel dang dmigs pa las/ /rim ni ji ltar skye ba bzhin/ phyin ci log gi gnyen po bzhi/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ zhi gnas grub par gyur pa yi gang zag chos can/ khyod kyis de nas lhag mthong bsgom par bya ste/ de yang dran pa nyer gzhag bsgom par bya ba yin la des lhag mthong 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dran pa nyer gzhag chos can/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhi yod de/ lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang de gsum las gzhan pa'i chos rnams la dmigs nas rang gi ngo bo rang mtshan dang*/ de dag gi byas mi rtag bdag med pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs su brtags nas bsgoms par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ rang bzhin dran nyer gzhag/'brel pa dran pa nyer gzhag/dmigs pa dran pa nyer gzhag gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi khyad par yod de/ lus sogs la rjes su lta ba'i shes rab thos sogs te bsam pa dang bsgoms pa las byung ba rnams dang po dang*/ gzhan de dag dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i sems byung 'du shes sogs gnyis pa/ 'brel ba dran pa nyer gzhag dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dran pa nyer gzhag dang 'brel ba'i dran pa nyer gzhag gnyis kyi dmigs pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag de dmigs pa dran pa nyer gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa la bzhi yod de/ lus tshor sems chos la dmigs pa'i de bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de re re la'ang gsum gsum yod de/ rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka'i rgyud la dmigs pa gsum gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i go rim ni yod de/ ji ltar skye ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snga ma snga ma rags la phyi ma phyi ma phra ba'i phyir/ bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gtsang ba de rtag bdag gi phyin ci log bzhi'i gnyen por rim par bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lus dran pa nyer gzhag ni lus gtsang 'dzin phyin ci log gi gnyen po dang*/ tshor ba dran nye ni bder 'dzin phyin ci log gi gnyen po dang*/ sems dran nyer gzhag ni rtag 'dzin phyin ci log gi gnyen po dang*/ chos dran nye ni bdag 'dzin phyin ci log bde gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ de ni chos dran nyer gzhag pa/ /spyi la dmigs pa la gnas te/ de dag la ni mi rtag dang*/ /sdug bsngal stong bdag med par lta/ /zhes byung*/ lus dran nye sogs gsum po de ni dmigs pa de ltar ma 'dres pa yin la/ chos dran pa nyer gzhag ni chos can/ 'dres pa'i spyi la dmigs nas gnas te/ lus sogs de dag la ni mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med par lta ba'i phyir/ de dag ni tshogs lam chen po nas bsgom pa'i dbang du byas so/

/gnyis pa la/ sbyor lam skabs kyi sgom tshul/ drod sogs skye rim gyi sgom tshul dang khyad chos/ zhar la theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ skye rim gyi tshul dang*/ phung po du yod dang*/ nges tshig gsum/ dang po ni/ de las dro bar gyur pa 'byung*/ /de ni bden bzhi'i spyod yul can/ /rnam pa bcu drug dro ba las/ /rtse mo de yang de dang 'dra/ /gnyis ka chos kyi rnam pa gtod/ /gzhan dag gis kyang 'phel bar byed/ /de las bzod pa gnyis de bzhin/ /thams cad chos kyis 'phel bar byed/ /chen po 'dod gtogs sdug bsngal yul/ /de ni skad cig gcig de bzhin/ /chos mchog ces byung*/ sbyor lam bzhi'i dang po sbyor lam dro bar gyur pa chos can/ skye tshul yod de/ tshogs lam du chos dran pa nyer gzhag bsgoms pa de las 'byung ba'i phyir/ sbyor lam drod de ni chos can/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yod de/ dmigs dang bden bzhi'i spyod yul can dang rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug po ci rigs la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ dro ba de las sbyor lam rtse mo 'byung zhing*/ rtse mo de yang chos can/ dmigs rnam gyi khyad par yod de/ sbyor lam drod de dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ drod rtse gnyis ka chos can/ bden bzhi la chos dran pa nyer gzhag gi rnam pa gtod pa'am 'god la/ dran pa nyer gzhag gzhan dag gis kyang 'phel bar byed de/ chung 'bring chen po gsum du rim gyis 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam bzod pa chos can/ rtse mo de las khyod skye ba yin te/ de khyod kyi dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa la chung 'bring chen po gsum las chung 'bring gnyis chos can/ dmigs rnam gyi khyad par yod de/ snga ma rtse mo de bzhin du yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam bzod pa chung 'bring chen po thams cad chos can/ gang gis 'phel bar byed pa yod de/ chos dran pa nyer gzhag gis 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir/

sbyor lam bzod pa chen po chos can/ dmigs rnam yod de/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yul du byed cing rnam pa phyi ma gnyis yid la byed pa'i phyir/ de ni chos can/ dmigs rnam de ltar yin kyang rnam pa gcig tu ma nges te/ sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi gang rung gi rnam pa can gyi skad cig ma gcig yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ dmigs rnam bzod pa chen po de bzhin du yin te/ dmigs pa 'dod pa'i sdug bden la dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa sdug bden gyi rnam pa mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med bzhi gang rung gi rnam pa can la/ rgyun ni skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam bzhi so so'i sgra don yod de/ bdag med rtogs pa'i sgom byung gi ye shes kyi me'i drod 'byung bas drod dang*/ dge ba g.yo ba'i rtse mor byin pas rtse mo dang*/ bden pa la bzod pa'i mi skrag pas bzod pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog yin pas na chos mchog zhes bya ba'i phyir/ spyir bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug yin yang khams gsum gyi sgo nas bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang*/ de dag la dmigs pa'i sbyor lam dang po gsum la chung 'bring chen po gsum ci rigs kyi sgo nas phye na mang du yod kyang*/ lugs 'dir chos mchog la de gsum gyi dbye ba mi byed de/ de ni skad cig ma gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thams cad phung po lnga/ thob pa ma gtogs zhes byung*/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi gtso bo dran pa nyer gzhag yin pas shes rab yin yang 'khor dang bcas na thams cad phung po lnga pa can yin te/ gzugs kyang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi thob pa chos can/ nges 'byed der ma gtogs te/ 'phags pa la'ang khyod rgyud ldan yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nges tshig ni/ nges 'byed cha mthun rnam pa bzhi/ zhes byung sbyor lam bzhi po de chos can/

nges 'byed cha mthun zhes bya ste/ nges 'byed ni 'phags lam yin la/ de'i cha shas mthong lam gyi phyogs gcig dang mthong lam de 'dren byed yin pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ grangs ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ rten gyi dang*/ bral thob kyi dang*/ de ldan pa'i yon tan dang*/ lam gzhan du 'jug tshul lnga/ dang po ni/ bsgoms byung*/ zhes byung*/ sngar bshad pa'i dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam bzhi chos can/ thos byung bsam byung bsgoms byung gsum po gang rung yin te/ bsgoms byung kho na yin pa'i phyir gnyis pa la/ sems rten dang*/ lus rten gnyis/ dang po ni/ mi lcogs med pa dang*/ khyad par bsam gtan sa pa'o/ /gnyis ni 'og na'ang yod pa'am/ zhes byung*/ sbyor lam chos can/ sa gang la brten pa yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med pa dang*/ khyad par du bsam gtan khyad par can dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sa rnams la brten pa'i phyir/ kha cig drod rtse gnyis 'og sa 'dod sems la brten pa'ang yod ces 'dod de/ 'am ni dpyad byar bzhed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod rten chos mchog bud med kyi/ /gnyis ka'i rten can 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ sbyor lam chos can/ khyod kyi lus rten yod de/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi gling gsum gyi mi'i rten la bzod pa chen po ma yin pa'i sbyor lam dang po gsum dang*/ phyi mas lha dag ni nang du mngon du byed pa yod la/ bzod pa chen po dang chos mchog chen po ni lha'i nang du'ang gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ thob tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ sngar skyes pa'i rten la thob pas ni phyis bud med kyi rten la mngon du 'gyur ba dang*/ sngar bud med kyi rten la thob pas ni phyis skyes pa'i rten la thob pa yod pas skyes pa bud med gnyis ka'i rten can la thob pa yod cing*/

skye ba brjes pa dang mtshan 'gyur pa las kyang de ltar du thob par 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bral thob kyi khyad par ni/ 'phags pa de dag sa bon nas/ gtong ngo 'phags min 'chi bas so/ /dang po gnyis yongs nyams pas kyang*/ /dngos gzhi de la bden pa mthong*/ /rnam par nyams na sngon med thob/ /nyams pa gnyis ni mi ldan pa/ /zhes byung*/ sbyor lam de dag chos can/ gang gis gtong ba yod de/ 'phags pas ni sa drug gang rung la brten pa'i sa de dag bor nas sam 'phos nas thob pa gtong*/ 'phags min so skyes ni 'chi 'phos pas sbyor lam de'i thob pa gtong ba'i phyir/ sbyor lam dang po gnyis chos can/ /gtong rgyu gzhan yod de/ log ltas yongs su nyams par byas nas kyang gtong ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam thob pa de chos can/ tshe de nyid la bden pa mngon sum du 'gyur te/ yid skyo shas che bas mthong lam du tshe der 'jug nus pa'i phyir/ rnam par nyams pa de chos can/ slar thob pa'i tshe sngon med pa nyid 'thob kyi btang ba ni thob pa min te/ ma 'dres pa dang 'bad de bsgrub par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ nyams pa chos can/ slar thob tshul gnyis yod de/ gang nyams pa'i 'phro nas skyed pa dang*/ gang nyams pa de slar gzhi nas skyed pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ yongs nyams dang rnam nyams kyi gang zag gnyis chos can/ sbyor lam gang nyams pa de dang mi ldan pa yin te/ de las nyams pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ rtse mo thob pa rtsa mi chad/ bzod thob ngan song mi 'gro'o/ / zhes byung*/ sbyor lam de dag chos can/ khyod thob pa la yon tan khyad par ba yod de/ khyod las drod thob la ma nyams pa lta zhog /nyams kyang sor chud de mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur la/ rtse mo thob pa ni mtshams med sogs byed pa yod kyang dge rtsa mi chad/ bzod pa thob pa'i tshe ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu mi gsog pas ngan song du mi 'gro la/

chos mchog gi tshe bden pa mthong ba la nye ba'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ gnyis slong rigs las bzlog nas ni/ /sangs rgyas su 'gyur gzhan gsum yang*/ /zhes byung*/ drod dang rtse mo gnyis la gnas pa chos can/ slob ma ste nyan thos kyi rigs las bzlog nas ni sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yod de/ nyan rang gang rung du rigs nges pas ma khyab pas byang sems kyi lam du 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir/ drod rtse bzod pa gsum la gnas pa chos can/ rang gi rigs las log nas gzhan du 'gyur ba yang yod de/ rang rgyal du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul ni/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar/ bsam gtan mtha' stan gcig la kun/ /de yi sngon du thar cha mthun/ /myur ba srid pa gsum gyi thar/ thos bsam las byung las gsum mo/ /mi yi nang du 'phen par byed/ /ces byung*/ rang rgyal rigs des dang bse ru lta bu ni rigs las ldog pa med de/ ston pa dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gnyis kyis drod nas zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub kyi bar gyi lam kun bsam gtan gyi mtha' bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas stan gcig la skyed par byed pa'i phyir/ dang po nas nges 'byed cha mthun skyed pa min te/ de yi sngon du thar pa cha mthun tshogs lam skyed dgos pa'i phyir/ nyan thos brtson 'grus shin tu che zhing myur ba chos can/ khyod srid pa ste tshe gsum gyis 'khor ba las thar bar 'gyur te/ tshe dang por thar cha/ gnyis pa la nges cha/ gsum pa la 'phags lam rdzogs par skyed nus pa'i phyir/ thar pa cha mthun de chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ thos bsam las byung ba gtso che ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ las gsum gyis bsdus pa yod kyang yid las gtso che ste/ byang chub 'dod pa'i yid las nyid gtso che ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ rten gang la skye ba yod de/ gling gsum gyi mi yi nang du 'phen pa ste skyed par byed pa'i phyir/gsum pa bden pa mngon rtogs bcu drug sgom tshul la/

skye rim/ grangs nges/ sa gang la brten pa/ spong gnyen gyi lam gang yin bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa yi chos mchog las/ /chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med/ /'dod sdug bsngal la de nas ni/ /de nyid la chos shes de bzhin/ /sdug bsngal lhag la rjes bzod shes/ /bden pa gsum la de bzhin no/ /zhes byung*/ 'jig rten pa yi chos mchog chos can/ khyod las 'phags lam skad cig ma bcu drug rim gyis skye ste/ dang por sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med pa 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs nas skye zhing*/ de nas ni sdug bden de nyid la dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes skye/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi lhag ma khams gong gi sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i rjes bzod skye/ de nas de la dmigs pa'i rjes shes skye la/ bden pa gzhan gsum la'ang de bzhin du sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor tshul yod de/ sdug bsngal chos shes kyi mjug tu 'dod pa'i kun 'byung chos bzod dang*/ kun 'byung chos shes/ de nas khams gong ma'i kun 'byung rjes bzod dang*/ kun 'byung rjes shes/ de nas 'dod pa'i 'gog pa chos bzod dang chos shes/ de nas gong ma'i 'gog pa rjes bzod dang rjes shes/ de nas 'dod pa'i lam chos bzod dang chos shes/ de nas gong ma'i lam rjes bzod dang rjes shes rnams rim gyis skye ba'i phyir/gnyis pa grangs nges ni/ de ltar bden pa mngon rtogs 'di/ /sems bcu drug go rnam gsum mo/ /mthong dmigs bya ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes byung*/ de ltar bshad pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs 'di chos can/ zag med kyi sems bcu drug tu nges te/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu nges pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gsum gsum du'ang 'gyur te/ mthong ba'i mngon rtogs/ dmigs pa'i mngon rtogs/ bya ba'i mngon rtogs zhes bya ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bden pa mthong ba'i sgo nas dang po/

mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung rnams gnyis pa/ bya ba nyid mngon par rtogs pa ni gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ spyi don gyis bshad na 'dod tshul mang yang*/ skye tshul la/ 'dir mngon rtogs bcu drug po thams cad rim can du skye bar 'dod cing*/ gzhan dag bzod pa brgyad cig car dang*/ shes pa brgyad cig car du skye bar 'dod pa dang mi 'dra'o/ /gsum pa sems rten ni/ de ni chos mchog dang gcig zhes byung*/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i sems de chos can/ khyod kyi sems rten yod de/ sbyor lam chos mchog dang sems rten sa gcig pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bsam gtan sa drug la brten cing*/ chos mchog dang mnyam gzhag thun gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gnyen po dang spong lam bshad pa ni/ bzod dang shes pa go rim bzhin/ /bar chad med dang rnam grol lam/ de las skad cig bco lnga ni/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam/ /zhes byung*/ skad cig bcu drug po de dag chos can/ gnyis su 'du ba ste/ bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam dang*/ shes pa brgyad rnam grol lam du go rim bzhin 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dang po brgyad ni rang gi spang bya dngos su spong ba la gzhan gyis bar du gcod mi nus shing*/ phyi ma brgyad ni spang bya de dag las rnam par grol ba'i sgo nas de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir/ de dag las skad cig snga ma bco lnga po ni chos can/ mthong ba'i lam yin te/ bden pa'i rnam pa sngar mngon sum ma mthong ba gsar du mthong ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ bcu drug pa chos can/ de min te/ mthong zin goms par byed pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ de dag las gnyen po dang spong lam gyi khyad par yod de/ bzod pa brgyad ni spang bya'i gnyen po yin pas gnyen po'i lam dang*/ shes pa brgyad ni spang pa la dbang bsgyur bas spong lam du 'jog pa'i phyir/gnyis pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/

nang tshan gyi sgo nas bdun du dbye ba/ gang zag gi rigs bsdus pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyun zhugs dang chags bral sngon song gi rnam gzhag dang*/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbang po rno rtul de dag tu/ dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang ba/ /sgom pa'i spang bya ma spangs pa/ /'bras bu dang po la zhugs pa/ /rnam lnga'i bar bcom gnyis pa la/ /dgu pa tshun chad zad pa yin/ /'dod pa'am yang na gong ma las/ /chags bral gsum pa la zhugs pa/ /gang zhig gang la zhugs pa ni/ /bcu drug pa la de 'bras gnas/ /de tshe dbang po rno rtul dag/dad pas mos dang mthong bas thob/ /'bras thob 'bras bu khyad par gyi/ /lam thob med pa de yi phyir/ /mi brtson pa ni zhugs ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ mngon rtogs de dag tu gnas pa'i gang zag chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ dbang po rno ba chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las sngon sgom pa'i spang bya gcig kyang ma spangs pa ni 'bras bu dang po la zhugs pa yin la/ de gcig nas rnam pa lnga'i bar bcom pa de yang de la zhugs pa yin te/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi sngon du 'dod pa'i sgom spang drug pa nas dgu pa tshun chad de brgyad pa zad pa de chos can/ 'bras bu gnyis pa phyir 'ong la zhugs pa yin te/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi sngon du 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'am/ yang na gong ma ci yang med man chad la 'dod chags dang bral ba de chos can/ 'bras bu gsum pa phyir mi 'ong la zhugs pa yin te/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhugs pa de gsum po gang zhig 'bras bu de gsum gang thob pa'i phyir zhugs pa de chos can/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa de'i tshe 'bras gnas gsum du rim par 'jog ste/

de'i tshe rgyun zhugs sogs gsum gyi 'bras bu gang yin pa de thob par 'jog pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe dbang po rno rtul de dag chos can/ dad pa dang chos kyi rjes 'brang zhes mi bya ste/ dbang rtul la dad pas mos pa dang dbang rnon la mthong bas thob pa zhes bya ba'i phy-ir/ 'bras bu thob pas ni 'bras bu gong ma thob pa'i phyir du mi brtson pa de chos can/ 'bras gnas gong ma de'i zhugs pa ma yin te/ 'bras bu khyad par can gyi zhugs pa'i lam thob pa med pa de yi phyir/ gnyis pa la spang bya spong tshul dang*/ zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa dang sa na nyes rnam dgu /de bzhin du ni yon tan rnams/ /chung dang 'bring dang che rnams kyi/ /chung ngu la sogs tha dad phyir/ /zhes byung*/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar gyi sa dang sa chos can/ khyod la nyes pa rnam pa dgu dgu yod de/ sgom spang chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po gsum dang*/ de re re la'ang chung ngu'i chung ngu nas chen po'i chen po'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du sgom lam gyi yon tan chos can/ dgu rnams yod de/ bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam re re la'ang*/ /chung ngu dang 'bring dang che rnams kyi chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa tha dad du dbye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rgyun zhugs zhugs 'bras/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom zhugs gnas dang bzhi/ dang po la gnyis kyi zhugs pa bshad zin cing*/ 'bras gnas la/ tsam po pa dang*/ khyad par can gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bras gnas sgom spang bya ma zad/ re ltar thogs na lan bdun pa/ zhes byung*/ rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa ba chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ 'bras bu la gnas pa gang zhig /sgom pa'i spang bya gcig kyang ma zad pa de ni/ rgyun zhugs re ltar thogs pa ste mchog tu'am rab tu thogs na 'dod par skye srid lan bdun len pa'i rigs can gyi rgyun zhugs yin pa'i phyir/

de la yang nges ma nges gnyis yod/ rgyun zhugs kyi sgra don yod de/ thar lam gyi rgyun la dang por zhugs pa'i rigs can yin pas na der brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam gsum rnam bzhi las grol ba/ /tshe gnyis gsum du rigs nas rigs/ /zhes byung*/ rgyun zhugs rigs nas rigs skye chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ 'bras bu gong ma thob phyir du zhugs pa gang zhig /'dod pa'i sgom spang nyon mongs rnam pa gsum mam/ rnam pa bzhi las grol ba dang*/ de'i gnyen po zag med kyi dbang po thob pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i lha'am mi'i tshe gnyis sam gsum las shing*/ lha mi gang rung gi rigs nas rigs su skye ba len pa'i rigs can de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam pa lnga yi bar bcom pa/ /gnyis pa la ni zhugs pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ gnyis pa rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong chos can/ khyod kyi zhugs pa yod de/ 'bras gnas gang zhig /sgom spang gcig nas rnam pa lnga'i bar bcom pa gang yin pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ tsam po ba dang*/ khyad par can gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam pa drug pa zad gyur pa/ de ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba/ /zhes byung*/ lan cig phyir 'ong pa'i 'bras gnas chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ 'bras gnas bzhi gang rung gang zhig /sgom spang rnam pa drug pa zad par gyur pas rab tu phye ba'i gang zag de ni de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyes cha bdun nam brgyad zad pa/ /tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa dang*/ zhes byung*/ phyir 'ong bar chad gcig pa chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ 'dod pa'i nyes pa'i chu bdun nam brgyad zad pa/ de'i gnyen po thob pa/ dgra bcom thob pa la tshe gcig dang phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa la bar chad gcig gis chod pa'i phyir 'ong de de yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/ zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsum pa la ni zhugs pa'ang yin/

zhes byung*/ phyir 'od 'bras gnas de chos can/ gsum pa phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu la zhugs pa'ang yin te/ de thob phyir du brtson pa'i phyir 'od 'bras gnas khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dgu zad pa phyir mi 'ong*/ zhes byung*/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas de chos can/ khyod thob pa'i dus yod de/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can des 'dod nyon dgu pa de nyid spangs shing zad pa'i tshe khyod du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ gzugs su nyer 'gro/ gzugs med nyer 'gro/ mthong chos zhi/ nyer 'gro dgur dbye ba/ tshe yongs gyur/ lus mngon byed dang drug /dang po la/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas lngar dbye ba dang*/ gong 'pho bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ni bar skyes 'du byed dang*/ /'du byed med yongs mya ngan 'da'/ /gong du 'pho ba rnams zhes byung*/ phyir mi 'ong de ni chos can/ khyod la dbye na lnga yod de/ bar do'i rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i bar 'da' ba dang*/ gzugs kyi skye srid kyi rten la de mngon du byed pa'i skyes nas 'da' ba dang*/ skyes nas 'bad brtson 'du byed dang bcas pas de mngon du byed pa'i 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba dang*/ 'bad rtsol chen po med par de mngon du byed pa'i 'du byed med par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang*/ gong du 'pho ba dang lnga rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rgyas par ni gzhan du shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ni/ /bsam gtan spel nas 'og min 'gro /de 'phar phyed 'phar thams cad du/ /'chi 'pho gzhan srid rtse mor 'gro/ /zhes byung*/ phyir mi 'ong gong 'pho de chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ bsam gtan spel sgom byas nas 'og min gyi mthar thug par 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan de ma byas par srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar 'gro ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong de chos can/

khyod la gsum yod de/ gzugs ky-i gnas gnyis gsum tsam gzung nas gzugs kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i 'phar ba dang*/ gnas gtsang du skyes kyang 'ga' zhig brgal nas 'og min du 'jug pa'i phyed du 'phar ba dang*/ tshangs chen ma gtogs pa'i gzugs kyi gnas thams cad du 'phos nas 'og min du 'jug pa'i gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan ni gzugs med 'gro rnam bzhi/ zhes byung*/ gzhan gzugs med nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong chos can/ khyod rnam pa bzhi yod de/ skye 'da' ba nas gong 'pho'i bar bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mthong chos zhi ni/ gzhan ni 'di la mya ngan 'da'/ zhes byung*/ gzhan phyir mi 'ong mthong chos zhi chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ nyer 'gro gnyis las gzhan pa'i phyir mi 'ong mthong lam thob pa'i tshe 'di la mya ngan las 'da' ba de de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ dgur bshad pa dang*/ de yi khyad par dang*/ dam pa'i 'gro ba bdun dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gsum la'ang rnam pa gsum phyin nas/ /gzugs su nyer 'gro dgur bshad do/ /ces byung*/ gzugs su nyer 'gro chos can/ khyod la dbye na dgur yod par bshad de/ bar 'da' ba dang*/ skye 'da' ba dang*/ gong du 'pho ba gsum la yang rnam pa gsum gsum du phye nas dgur yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dang po la myur bar dang*/ myur ba min par dang*/ dus ring nas 'da' ba gsum/ gnyis pa la skyes tsam nas dang*/ 'du byed dang bcas te dang*/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba gsum/ gsum pa la 'phar ba dang*/ phyed 'phar ba dang*/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag gi ni khyad par rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs bye brag la/ /zhes byung*/ phyir mi 'ong dgu po de dag gi chos can/ khyad par rnams de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ las dang dbang po dang nyon mongs pa'i bye brag las bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/

dang po gsum mngon par 'grub pa'i las kyi dang*/ bar pa gsum skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las dang*/ phyi ma gsum lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las dang*/ yang rim pa bzhin dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum dang*/ yang rim pa bzhin nyon mongs chung 'bring chen po gsum gyi bye brag gam khyad par gyis bzhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gong du 'pho ba ma phye bar/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba bdun du 'dod/ /dam pa dam min 'jug mi 'jug /son pa phyir mi 'ong phyir de/ /zhes byung*/ mdo las bstan pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba de chos can/ khyod la bdun du yod de/ sngar gyi dgu po de las gong du 'pho ba ma phye bar gcig tu bgrang bas bdun du yong ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ dam pa zhes bya ste/ dam pa dge ba kho nar 'jug cing*/ dam min mi dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong zhes bya ste/ 'dod pa las son zhing rang sa dang 'og sar tshe phyi mar slar mi 'ong ba'i 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa tshe yongs gyur pa/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur pa'i 'phags/ khams gzhan du ni 'gro ba med/ /de dang gong mar skyes pa na/ /yongs nyams dbang po 'pho mi bsten/ /zhes byung*/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur gyi 'phags pa chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu gang rung thob nas 'dod pa'i tshe gnyis par phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhig de yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khams gzhan du ni 'gro ba med de/ 'dod pa'i tshe de nyid la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ de dang khams gong mar skyes pa'i 'phags pa chos can/ yongs su nyams dang dbang po 'pho ba mi bsten te/ mi nyams pa dang dbang po mi 'pho ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po bzhi pa spel bar byed/ skad cig ma ni bsres pas 'grub/ /skye dang gnas par bya phyir dang*/

nyon mongs bas ni 'jig phyir yang*/ /de ni rnam pa lnga yi phyir/ /gnas gtsang skye ba lnga kho na/ /zhes byung*/ phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom kha cig chos can/ khyod kyis bsam gtan spel sgom byed pa'i tshe dang por bsam gtan bzhi pa spel bar byed pa yin te/ de bsam gtan gzhan gyi mchog yin pa'i phyir/ spel tshul yod de/ bsam gtan zag med gnyis kyi bar du zag bcas dang*/ de las bzlog pa sogs skad cig ma re re bzhin bsres pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ gnas gtsang du skye ba dang*/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nyon mongs ma spangs pa'i dbang rdul 'ga' zhig nyon mongs pas ni 'jig pa de zhi ba'i phyir yang sgom par byed pa'i phyir/ bsgom tshul lngar nges te/ gnas gtsang mar skye ba'i gnas la mi che ba sogs lnga kho na yin pas der skye ba'i rgyu bsam gtan spel sgom byed tshul de ni rnam pa lnga kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ spel sgom chos can/ khyod la lnga yod de/ chung ngu gsum du spel ba/ 'bring drug tu spel ba/ chen po dgur spel ba/ shin tu che ba bcu gnyis su spel ba/ shin tu ches cher bco lngar spel ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ drug pa na/ 'gog pa thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong*/ lus kyis mngon sum byed par 'dod/ /ces byung*/ phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong de phyir mi 'ong lus kyis mngon du byed par 'dod pa'i phyir/ lus kyis mngon du byed ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems sam tshor 'du 'gag pa'i lus la brten nas snyoms 'jug de skye ba'i phyir/ spyir phyir mi 'ong la dbye na khri nyis stong dgu brgya dang drug cu yod de/ phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba sogs rigs lnga po re re la'ang nyis stong lnga brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis re yod par rang 'grel las bshad pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa dgra bcom zhugs 'bras la/ zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ srid rtse'i bar cha brgyad zad pa/ /dgra bcom nyid la zhugs pa yin/ /dgu pa'i bar chad med lam yang*/ /de ni rdo rje lta bu yin/ /zhes byung*/ dgra bcom zhugs pa chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i sgom spang gcig spangs gnas srid rtse'i bar gyi sgom spang gi cha brgyad pa zad pa'i phyir mi 'ong rnams dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu la zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ srid nyon dgu pa'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i 'bras gnas gzhan de yang de yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med lam de chos can/ rdo rje lta bu ting nge 'dzin yin te/ rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam ltar nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms shing 'bigs pa'i sgom lam bar chad med lam mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'bras gnas la/ dngos dang*/ khyad chos dang*/ dbye ba gsum/ dang po na/ de zad thob dang zad pa shes/ /de tshe de mi slob dgra bcom/ zhes byung*/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas chos can/ khyod thob pa'i dus yod de/ srid nyon dgu pa de zad pa'i bral ba thob pa dang lhan cig zag pa zad pa'i shes bskyed pa de'i tshe thob pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i tshe khyod kyi zhugs pa des lam de'i gong du slob mi dgos pa'i rang lam gyi mi slob pa'i lam gsar du thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ chags bral gyi rnam gzhag dang*/ dge sbyong tshul gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ gang gis chags pa dang bral ba'i lam dang*/ dral thob skye tshul/ sa gang gi gang la chags pa dang bral ba/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi dmigs rnam bshad pa bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten 'das kyis srid rtsa las/ chags bral gzhan ni rnam pa gnyis/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ lam gang gis gang la chags pa dang bral bar byed tshul yod de/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam gyis srid rtse las chags pa dang bral bar byed pa/

srid rtse las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs brgyad ni 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi sgom lam rnam pa gnyis kyis chags bral byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa yi chags bral ba'i/ /'phags pa bral ba'i thob rnam gnyis/ kha cig 'jig rten 'das kyis kyang*/ /btang la nyon mongs mi ldan phyir/ /srid rtse'i byed las rnam grol dang*/ /gong du skyes pa bzhin mi ldan/ zhes byung*/ 'phags pa 'jig rten pa yi lam gyis 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur pa chos can/ khyod la 'phags pa'i bral ba'i thob pa 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das rnam pa gnyis yod de/ 'jig rten pa'i zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi lam dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis kyang 'dod chags dang bral ba rnam pa gnyis yod de/ lam gong ma btang ba la de'i nyon mongs dang mi ldan pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ 'das lam gy-is srid rtse'i phyed las rnam par grol ba'i phyir mi 'ong 'ga' zhig dbang po 'phos pa na lam snga ma btang zhing 'jig rten pa'i bral thob med kyang srid rtse'i nyon mongs slar mi ldan pa dang*/ 'dod par chags bral gyi so skye bsam gtan dang po yan gyi gong du skyes pa la 'dod pa'i nyon mongs dang bral ba'i thob pa zag bcas btang bas bral thob med kyang 'dod nyon slar mi ldan pa bzhin yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ zag med mi lcogs med pa yis/ /thams cad pa ni 'dod chags bral/ /sa gsum las rgyal bsam gtan nam/ /nyer bsdogs las mtha'i rnam grol lam/ /gong ma'i nyer bsdogs las min 'phags/ /brgyad kyi rang gong sa las rgyal/ /zhes byung*/ zag med kyi sa chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs zag med dang*/ dang po'i dngos gzhi zag med tsam khyad gnyis dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma gsum gyi dngos gzhi zag med dang*/

gzugs med gsum gyi zag med gsum dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ de las bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med pa yis chos can/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar gyi sa thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed nus te/ bar chad med lam gyi bdag nyid dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas de ltar nus pa'i phyir te/ des 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po gnyis te sa 'og ma gsum lam 'dod chags dang bral nas rgyal ba'i rnam grol lam thob pa'i tshe/ rnam grol lam gnyis thob ste/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'am/ nyer bsdogs las mthong ste rnam grol lam tha ma'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi sogs gong ma la chags pa dang bral ba'i rnam grol lam chos can/ tha ma'i nyer bsdogs las skye ba min te/ dngos gzhi kho na las skye ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i zag med kyi bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med dang po gsum dang dngos gzhi zag med brgyad chos can/ khyod kyis rang sa dang gong sa las rgyal bar byed kyi/ 'og sa las min te/ de las sngar 'dod chags dang bral zin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dmigs rnam la/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi dmigs rnam dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mthar grol lam skye tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa yi rnam grol dang*/ /bar chad med lam go rim bzhin/ /zhi sogs rags sogs rnam pa can/ /gong dang 'og ma'i sbyang yul can/ /zhes byung*/ 'jig rten pa yi rnam grol lam dang de'i bar chad med lam gnyis chos can/ dmigs rnam yod de/ go rim bzhin du snga mas sa gong ma la zhi ba dang gya nom pa sogs kyi rnam pa can gyi ngo bor spyod yul du byed la/ phyi mas ni sa 'og ma la rags pa dang dman pa sogs kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas spyod yul du byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te mi g.yo zad shes las/ mi skye'i blo gros gal te min/ /zad pa shes sam mi slob lta/ /de ni dgra bcom thams cad la/ /zhes byung*/

gal te dgra bcom pa de chos can/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can yin na zad pa shes pa las mi skye ba'i blo gros te shes pa skye la/ gal te de min na de las zad pa shes pa'i rgyun nam/ mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba gang rung skye ste/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu chad pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa'i lta ba de ni chos can/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom la'ang yod de/ dgra bcom pa thams cad la yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la/ ngo bo dbye ba dang bcas pa dang*/ mdo dang 'gal ba'i rtsod pa spangs pa dang*/ ma khyab snyam pa'i dogs gcod dang*/ 'thob pa'i tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ dge slong tshul ni dri med lam/ /'bras bu 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de dang brgyad cu rtsa dgu'o/ /grol lam zad pa rnams dang bcas/ /zhes byung*/ dge sbyong gi tshul chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ dri med de zag med bar chad med lam la 'jog pa'i phyir/ bar chad med lam de chos can/ dge sbyong gi tshul yin te/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag don dam pa'i dge sbyong du 'jog byed kyi tshul te lam yin pa'i phyir/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang 'dus ma byas 'gog bden gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis po de dag chos can/ re re la'ang brgyad cu rtsa dgu re yod de/ mthong spang spangs pa'i rnam grol lam brgyad dang*/ sa dgu'i sgom spang spangs pa'i rnam grol lam dgu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig /zad pa 'gog bden dang bcas pa rnams la'ang de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ spyi don gyis cung zad bshad na/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu yin na/ 'bras bu yin pas ma khyab ste/ 'dus ma byas 'gog bden rnams 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu thob pa'i gang zag yin na/ 'bras bu bzhi gang rung dang ldan pas ma khyab ste/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu thob pa'i sangs 'phags yod pa'i phyir/

rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la so skye med de/ 'dir zhugs pa bzhi po gang rung la'ang 'phags pas khyab pa'i phyir/ nyan thos mthong lam rnam grol lam la gnas pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas med de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas la sgom lam pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'bras gnas dang po gsum la sgom lam pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chags bral sngon song gi 'bras gnas la bcu drug pa lam rjes shes thob dgos shing*/ de nyid skabs 'dir sgom lam du 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu bzhi gang rung thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i nyan thos yin na/ de gang rung gi zhugs pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ de dag thob phyir brtson bzhin pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong gang rung gi zhugs pa yin na/ mthong lam pa yin pas khyab/ bar pa gnyis kyi rim gyis pa'i zhugs pa yin na/ sgom lam pa yin pas khyab ste/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can dang*/ phyi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can la sgom lam pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu bzhir rnam bzhag pa ni/ rgyu lnga dag ni srid phyir ro/ /'bras la sngon lam btang ba dang*/ /gzhan thob pa dang zad bsdoms dang*/ /shes pa brgyad tshan thob pa dang*/ /rnam pa bcu drug thob pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu brgyad cu rtsa dgur bshad pa de chos can/ /mdo las 'bras bu bzhir bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i skyon med de/ bzhir rnam par bzhag pa ni rgyu mtshan dag ni rnam pa lnga srid pa'i phyir/ gang zhe na yod de/ 'bras bu la rang gi zhugs lam sngon du btang ba dang*/ zhugs pa las gzhan pa'i 'bras gnas kyi lam thob pa dang*/ mthong spang thams cad zad pa bsdoms pa'i thob pa gcig rnyed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal chos shes sogs shes pa brgyad tshan thob pa dang*/ rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam thob pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dogs gcod ni/

'jig rten pa yi thob 'bras ni/ /bsres dang zag med thob 'dzin phyir/ /de nyid tshangs tshul tshangs pa yi/ /'khor lo tshangs pas bskor phyir ro/ /chos kyis 'khor lo mthong ba'i lam/ /myur bar 'gro sogs rtsibs sogs kyis/ /zhes byung*/ kho na re/ chags bral sngon song gi bar pa gnyis khyi 'bras bu de dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bur ji ltar rung zhe na/ de gnyis chos can/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bur mi rung ba'i skyon med de/ 'jig rten pa'i thob 'bras tsam ma yin par 'jig rten pa'i thob 'bras ni mthong lam gyi bral 'bras der bsres pa dang zag med kyi thob pa yang 'dzin pa'i phyir/ dge sbyong gi tshul de nyid chos can/ tshangs pa'i tshul zhes bya ste/ myang 'das ni tshangs pa yin la/ de thob byed kyi tshul lam lam yin pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa yi 'khor lo chos can/ skor ba po yod de/ tshangs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bskor ba'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad chos can/ chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khor lo rin po che ni de la rten par byed pa'i lte ba dang*/ sdud cing myur bar 'gro sogs kyi mu khyud dang*/ gcod par byed pa'i rtsibs sogs gsum yod pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang dag pa'i ngag dang las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba gsum lte ba dang mtshungs/ yang dag pa'i lta ba rtog pa rtsol ba gsum ni rtsibs dang mtshungs/ yang dag pa'i dran pa ting nge 'dzin gnyis ni mu khyud dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/bzhi pa 'thob tshul ni/ 'dod par gsum thob tha ma ni/ gsum du'o gong na mthong lam med/ /mi skyo lung las 'dir rtsom zhing*/ /de mthar phyin ces 'byung phyir ro/ /zhes byung*/ 'bras bu bzhi po de chos can/ khams gsum gang gi rten la thob pa yod de/ 'dod par 'bras bu dang po gsum thob cing*/

'bras bu tha ma dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu ni khams gsum gyi rten du thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dang po dang chags bral sngon song gi bar pa gnyis dang gsum khams gong du gsar du thob pa med de/ de na mthong lam gsar du thob pa med pa'i phyir te/ de na skyo shas chen po mi skye ba'i phyir/ de ni rigs pa'i sgrub byed yin la/ lung gi sgrub byed kyang yod de/ mdo las phyir mi 'ong bar dor 'da' ba sogs lnga po 'dir lam la rtsom zhing lam gong ma de mthar phyin ces 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi dbye ba la/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas drug tu dbye ba/ gnyis su bsdu ba/ rigs dang 'bras bu gang las nyams pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba de gzhan la sbyang ba/ nyams pa'i dbye ba/ dbang po 'pho tshul/ dgra bcom dgur dbye ba dang bdun/ dang po ni/ dgra bcom drug 'dod ces byung*/ dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod la drug tu yod par 'dod de/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can/ 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can/ rjes su srung ba'i chos can/ gnas pa mi bskyod pa dang rtogs pa'i skal ba can dang mi g.yo ba'i chos can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag las/ lnga ni dad pa'i mos las skyes/ /de dag rnam grol dus dang sbyor/ /mi g.yo chos can mi g.yo ba/ /de sbyor de dus mi sbyor grol/ /de ni mthong thob rgyu las byung*/ kha cig dang po nas de'i rigs/ kha cig sbyangs pa las gyur to/ /zhes byung*/ dgra bcom de dag rnams las mi g.yo ba'i chos can ma gtogs pa'i dang po lnga chos can/ rgyu yod de/ rang rgyu dad pa sems pa las skyes pa'i phyir/ lnga po de dag chos can/ rnam grol dus dang sbyor zhes bya ste/ myang 'das mngon du byed pa la yo byad dang nad med pa dang yul gyi khyad par la ltos pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom chos can/ rnam grol dus dang mi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/

dbang po mi g.yo zhing nyon mongs pas kyang mi g.yo ba de'i phyir/ de ni chos can/ gang las byung ba yod de/ mthong bas thob pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ drug po de dag chos can/ dang po nas de dang de'i rigs can du ma nges te/ kha cig dang po nas de'i rigs can dang*/ kha cig dang po nyams pa'i chos can yin yang dbang po sbyang ba las gzhan du 'gyur ba yod cing mi g.yo ba'i chos can du 'gyur ba yang yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bzhi ni rigs las lnga 'bras las/ /nyams 'gyur dang po las ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ dgra bcom lnga chos can/ rigs dang 'bras bu las nyams tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ bshad tshul gnyis snang ba las gcig ni nyams pa'i chos can sogs bzhi ni rigs las nyams pa yod/ lnga po 'bras bu las nyams par 'gyur ba yod kyang*/ rang gi 'bras bu gang dang por thob pa las nyams par 'gyur ba yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ bshad tshul cung mi 'dra ba yod de/ dang po nyams pa'i chos can ni rigs dma' shos yin pas de las nyams pa med cing*/ 'chi bar sems pa sogs bzhi rigs las nyams pa yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ni rang 'grel dang mthun no/ /bzhi pa la/ dngos dang*/ lam gang las dbang po 'pho ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dang 'phags min rig drug ldan/ zhes byung*/ 'phags pa slob pa dang 'phags min so skye chos can/ nyams pa'i chos can nas mi g.yo ba'i bar rigs drug dang ldan te/ dgra bcom drug gi rigs can re re yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong ba la ni 'pho ba med/ /ces byung*/ lam gzhan la dbang po 'pho ba yod kyang mthong ba'i lam chos can/ khyod la gnas pa la dbang po 'pho ba med de/ yun thung bas dbang po mi 'pho zhing de'i sbyor ba med pa'i phyir/ lnga po ni/ thob dang ma thob nyer spyad las/ /yongs nyams rnam pa gsum zhes bya/ /ston la tha ma mi g.yo ba/ /bar ma'ang gzhan la rnam gsum mo/ /'bras las nyams pa 'chi ba med/ /bya ba ma yin de mi byed/

/ces byung*/ yongs su nyams pa de chos can/ /rnam pa gsum zhes bya ba yin te/ yon tan thob pa shong ba ni/ /thob pa las nyams pa dang*/ /thob bya ma thob pa ni ma thob pa las nyams pa dang*/ thob kyang mngon du mi byed pa'i nyer spyad las nyams pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ ston pa chos can/ de gsum gyi tha ma nyer spyod las nyams pa yod de/ 'gog snyoms thob kyang mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can yal bar mi 'dor ba'i snying rje chen pos bcings pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom chos can/ bar ma thob pa las nyams pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa sogs ma thob pa'i nyin thos yin pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom gzhan chos can/ nyams pa rnam pa gsum yod de/ 'bras bu las nyams pa sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gal te dgra bcom pa nyams nas 'khor bar skye bar 'gyur srid dam snyam na/ de med par thal/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las nyams pa ni 'bras bu de sor ma chud bar du 'chi ba med cing*/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ma yin pa mi byed pa'i phyir te/ rtsal po che 'dred kyang rdeg mi 'cha' ba bzhin no/ /drug pa dbang po 'pho tshul ni/ mi g.yo rnam grol bar chad med/ /lam dgu'i shin tu bsten phyir ro/ /mthong bas thob pa re re'o/ /zag med mi yi nang du 'phel/ /mi slob sa dgu la brten te/ slob pa drug la gang gi phyir/ /'phel ba 'bras bu khyad par can/ /btang ste 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ gong gi dgra bcom de dag las gang gis 'pho tshul gyi khyad par ni/ rtogs pa'i skal pa can mi g.yo bar dbang po 'pho na zag med kyi lam bco brgyad dgos te/ rnam grol lam dgu dang bar chad med lam dgu dgos pa'i phyir te/ dbang po rtul po'i rigs te goms pa shin tu bsten pas bzlog dka' ba'i phyir/ dad mos pa mthong thob par dbang po 'pho ba la bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gang rung re res chog ste/

dbang po 'pho sla ba'i phyir/ slob pa 'phags pa chos can/ dbang po 'pho tshul yod de/ zag med kyi lam la brten nas 'pho shing*/ rten mi'i nang du 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mi slob pa chos can/ gang la brten nas dbang po 'pho ba yod de/ zag med mi lcogs med pa nas gzugs med dang po gsum tshun gyi dgu gang rung la brten nas 'pho ba'i phyir/ slob pa phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong dang mos pa gnyis chos can/ dbang po 'pho tshul yod de/ zag med kyi bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten nas 'pho ba'i phyir/ de dag gi dbang po chos can/ de ltar 'pho ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ dbang rtul gyi dbang po 'phel bas rang gi lam dang 'bras bu khyad par can btang ste dbang rnon gyi 'bras bu phyi ma 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bdun pa dgra bcom dgur dbye ba ni/ de dgu dbang po rnam dgu can/ /gang zag bdun po sbyor ba dang*/ /dbang po snyoms 'jug rnam grol dang*/ /gnyis kas byas pa'o zhes byung*/ dgra bcom chos can/ khyod la dbang po'i bye brag gi dgur dbye ba yod de/ rang rgyal dgra bcom dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang nyan thos bdun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dgu po de chos can/ dbang po rnam pa dgu pa can yin te/ dbang po chen po'i chen po nas chung ngu'i bar so sor yod pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi gang zag bdun po de chos can/ sbyor ba dang dbang po dang snyoms 'jug dang rnam grol dang gnyis ka'i cha nas rdzogs pa'am shes par 'jog pa yin te/ dad pa dang chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis sbyor ba dang*/ dad mos thob gnyis dbang po dang*/ lus mngon byed snyoms 'jug dang*/ nyon mongs las rnam par grol ba tsam ni shes rab kyi rnam par grol ba dang*/ nyon mongs las gol ba dang 'gog pa thob pa gnyis ka byas pa'i cha nas gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gang zag gi rigs bsdu ba dang*/

rnam grol gyi khyad par gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag drug /'di ltar lam gsum la gnyis gnyis/ zhes byung*/ gang zag bdun po de dag chos can/ rdzas kyi sgo nas drug tu 'gyur te/ 'di ltar mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum la gnyis gnyis 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mthong lam la rjes 'brang gnyis/ sgom lam la dad mos dang mthong thob gnyis/ mi slob lam la dus kyi rnam grol dang*/ dus mi sbyaur gyi rnam par grol ba gnyis 'jog pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'gog thob gnyis ka las rnam grol/ /shes rab kyis ni cig shos so/ /zhes byung*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob pa'i dgra bcom pa chos can/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ste/ nyon mongs spangs shing snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam spangs pa'i dgra bcom de chos can/ cig shos shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba zhes bya ste/ shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa tsam las grol ba'i dgra bcom yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa yan lag gi rdzogs tshul ni/ snyoms 'jug dbang po 'bras rnams kyis/ /slob pa rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis kyis mi slob yongs su rdzogs/ /zhes byung*/ slob pa chos can/ rdzogs byed kyi chos gsum yod de/ snyoms 'jug dang dbang po dang 'bras bu rnams kyis rdzogs pa zhes bya bar 'jog pa'i phyir te/ phyir mi 'ong dad mos pa lus mngon byed min pa ni 'bras bu kho nas rdzogs/ mthong thob chags bral min pa ni dbang po kho nas rdzogs/ lus mngon byed min pa'i phyir mi 'ong mthong thob pa ni 'bras bu dang dbang pos rdzogs/ dad mos lus mngon byed ni 'bras bu dang snyoms 'jug gis rdzogs/ mthong thob lus mngon byed ni 'bras bu dbang po snyoms 'jug gsum gyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa chos can/ chos gnyis kyis rdzogs te/ dbang po dang snyoms 'jug gis yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa la/ lam gyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ lam gyis thob pa'i rnam grol lam ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ rigs bsdus bzhir bshad pa dang*/ dka' sla myur bul bzhir bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdor na lam ni rnam bzhi ste/ khyad par can dang rnam grol dang*/ /bar chad med dang sbyor zhes bya/ /zhes byung*/ lam gyi khyad par mang du bshad pa dag las mdor bsdu na 'bras bu thob byed kyi lam ni chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ khyad par gyi lam dang*/ rnam grol lam dang*/ bar chad med pa'i lam dang*/ sbyor ba'i lam zhes bya ba bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po dang phyi ma gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ rnam grol lam yan chad ni khyad par gyi lam dang*/ bar chad med lam la 'jug pa'i lam ni sbyor ba'i lam yin la/ bar pa gnyis sla ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan dag gi lam rnams sla/ /sa gzhan dag ni dka' ba yin/ /blo rtul mngon shes bul ba ste/ cig shos kyi ni mngon shes myur/ /zhes byung*/ lam de chos can/ khyod la dka' sla myur bur bzhi yod de/ /sems rten dang dbang po'i sgo nas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ sa'i sgo nas dka' sla gnyis yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi yan lag gis zin pa dang zhi lhag cha snyoms pa ni lam rnams bskyed pa sogs sla la/ sa gzhan bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can dang nyer bsdogs brgyad dag ni lhag mthong shas che bas lam dka' zhing*/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi bzhi ni zhi gnas shas che bas lam dka' ba'i phyir/ dka' sla de gnyis chos can/ khyod la myur bul gnyis re yod de/ blo rtul po ni mngon shes bul pa ste/ cig shos rnon po ni mngon shes myur ba dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ming gi sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bsdu ba/ sde tshan gyi go rim/ ngo bo'i khyad par/

sa gang gis bsdus pa/ zhar byung shes nas dad pa thob tshul dang drug /dang po ni/ zad dang mi skye shes pa ni/ /byang chub de dang mthun nyid phyir/ /sum cu rtsa bdun de'i phyogs mthun/ /ming gi sgo nas zhes byung*/ theg gsum rang rang zad dang mi skye shes pa'i ye shes chos can/ rang rang gi byang chub gsum po gang yin pa de zhes bya ste/ rang rang gi spang bya nyon mongs pa spangs shing thob bya rdzogs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ dran pa nyer gzhag sogs byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po chos can/ byang chub de'i phyogs dang mthun pa zhes bya ste/ de skyed pa dang mthun pa'i lam nyid yin pa'i phyir/ so bdun po chos can/ ming gi sgo nas 'jog tshul yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi nas 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi bar du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rdzas su bcu/ dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang*/ /shes rab ting 'dzin btang snyoms dga'/ /rtog dang tshul khrims shin tu sbyangs/ /dran pa nyer gzhag shes rab ste/ /brtson 'grus yang dag 'jog ces bya/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting 'dzin to/ /gtso bo smos pa de dag ni/ /sbyor byung yon tan kun kyang yin/ /zhes byung*/ so bdun po de dag chos can/ rdzas su bcur 'du ba yin te/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ btang snyoms dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang bcur 'du ba'i phyir te/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi shes rab dang*/ yang dag spong ba bzhi brtson 'grus dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ting nge 'dzin du 'du zhing*/ dad sogs dbang stobs kyi rdzas lnga dang*/ byang chub yan lag lnga'i rdzas dang bcur 'du ba'i phyir/ dran nye shes rab tu bshad pa sogs ni gtso bo smros pa yin gy-i der nges nas ni min te/ dran pa nyer gzhag sogs de dag ni rang rang gi sbyor ba de'i stobs kyis byung ba'i yon tan sems byung kun kyang de nyid yin pa'i phyi/gsum pa ni/

sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin/ /las ni dang po pa dag dang*/ /nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang ni/ /mthong dang sgom la rab tu phye/ /zhes byung*/ bye smra na re/ so bdun gyi sde tshan bdun ni chos can/ 'jog pa'i go rim yod de/ las ni dang po pa tshogs lam pa dag dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam rnams la go rim bzhin du bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dran nye tshogs lam/ yang dag spong ba drod dang*/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rtse mo dang*/ dbang po bzod pa dang*/ stobs rnams chos mchog nas dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag sgom lam dang 'phags lam yan lag rnams mthong lam la rab tu phye nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ slob dpon sogs na re/ go rim yod de/ gzhan phal cher 'dra ba la dran nye sogs sde tshan gsum ni tshogs lam chung 'bring chen po gsum dang*/ dbang stobs gnyis drod dang bzod pa nas skye bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ byang chub/ yan lag lam yan lag /zag pa med gzhan rnam gnyis so/ /zhes byung*/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang 'phags lam yan lag chos can/ zag med yin te/ 'phags lam zag med yin pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ zag bcas zad med gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ lam bden yin min gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po thams cad na/ /mi lcogs med na dga' ma gtogs/ /gnyis pa na ni rtog ma gtogs/ /gnyis na de gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /bsam gtan par na'ang gzugs med pa/ /gsum na'ang de dang tshul yan lag /byang chub dang ni lam yan lag /ma gtogs 'dod khams srid rtse na/ / zhes byung*/ sde tshan bdun po de chos can/ khams dang sa gang na yod med kyi khyad par yod de/ bsam gtan dang po na so bdun po thams cad yod/ mi lcogs med na dga' ba ma gtogs pa'i so drug /bsam gtan gnyis pa na ni yang dag pa'i rtog pa ma gtogs pa'i so drug /bsam gtan gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis na dga' rtog de gnyis ma gtogs pa'i so lnga dang*/

de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi bar nyer bsdogs gsum dang dang po khyad par can gsum na'ang de dang 'dra la/ gzugs med dang po gsum na'ang yang dag pa'i ngag dang las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba ste/ 'phags lam yan lag gi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshul khrims kyi yan lag gsum dang dga' rtog gnyis min pa so gnyis/ 'dod khams dang srid rtse na byang chub yan lag dang lam yan lag gnyis ma gtogs pa'i nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bshad pa ni sas bsdus kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ 'dod khams pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la byang chub dang 'phags lam gyi yan lag med pa'i don min la/ gzugs med nas yang dag pa'i ngag sogs gsum med par bshad pa ni/ lugs 'dir de gsum po gzugs can du 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te zhib cha gyis shig/drug pa ni/ bden gsum mthong ba tshul khrims chos la shes nas dad pa 'thob/ /lam mngon rtogs na sangs rgyas dang*/ /de yi dge 'dun dag la yang*/ /chos bden gsum dang rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam yin no/ /rdzas su gnyis te dad pa dang*/ /tshul khrims dri ma med pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ mdo las chos shes nas dad pa thob tshul la bzhi bshad de/ bden pa dang po gsum mngon sum du mthong na 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims dang chos la shes nas dad pa 'thob/ lam bden mngon sum du rtogs na sangs rgyas dang de yi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dag la yang shes nas dad pa thob par bshad pa'i phyir/ de'i dmigs yul gyi ches chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ bden pa dang po gsum dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams ni de yin pa'i phyir/ dad pa'i yul gyi khyad par chos can/ bzhir bshad kyang rdzas su gnyis yin te/ dkon mchog sogs la dad pa ni dad pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phyogs gnyis su 'du ba yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i dad pa chos can/ zag med yin te/ yang dag pa'i don legs par rtogs nas yid ches pa'i dri ma med pa'i dad pa yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa lam gyis thob pa'i rnam grol lam la/ rnam grol lam gyi dbye ba/ thob tshul/ 'dus ma byas kyi rnam grol bye brag tu bshad pa/ yid 'byung dang chags bral gyi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ bcings phyir slob pa'i yan lag tu/ /rnam grol ma bshad de rnam gnyis/ /nyon mongs bcom pa 'dus ma byas/ /mos pa 'dus byas yan lag ni/ /de yin de nyid rnam grol gnyis/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ slob pa'i yan lag tu yang dag pa'i rnam grol lam dang yang dag pa'i shes pa ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ slob pa ni nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ yang dag pa'i shes pa ni 'dir nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ rnam grol lam de chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ nyon mongs rnams bcom pa'i 'dus ma byas so sor brtags 'gog dang*/ mi slob pa'i mos pa 'dus byas kyi rnam grol gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa'i mos pa rnam grol lam chos can/ mi slob pa'i lam yan lag yin te/ de'i mngon rtogs de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas rnam grol lam de nyid chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba zhes mdo las gsungs pa ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems gang rnam par grol ba dang*/ lam gang gis rnam par grol ba gnyis/ /dang po ni/ byang chub ji skad bshad shes pa/ /mi slob sems ni skye 'gyur ba/ /sgrib pa las ni rnam grol 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang grol ba'i dus chos can/ so sor bzhag tu yod de/ byang chub ji skad bshad pa'i shes pa mi slob pa'i sems ni dus gsum las ma 'ongs pa skye bar 'gyur na de sgrib pa las ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba de yin la/ mi slob pa'i sems skyes zin pa'i tshe sems rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa na sems nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i dus yin la/

des nyon mongs pa spangs pa na de las rnam par grol ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gag par 'gyur ba'i lam gyis ni/ de yi sgrib pa rab tu spaung*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ lam gang gis mi slob lam skye ba'i sgrib pa spong bar byed pa yod de/ rdo rje lta bu'i lam 'gag bzhin pa khams 'gag par 'gyur ba'i lam gyis ni de yi sgrib pa rab tu spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dus ma byas nyid khams zhes bya/ /'dod chags kun zad 'dod chags bral/ /spangs pa'i khams ni gzhan dag go /'geg pa'i khams zhes bya ba gzhi/ /zhes byung*/ rnam grol 'dus ma byas nyid kyi khams zhes bya ba de chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ spangs pa'i khams dang*/ 'dod chags kun zad pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i zag bcas spangs pa'i khams dag yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs spangs pa'i spangs pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kun spangs pa'i spangs pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ de dag las gzhan pa'i zag bcas spangs pa'i spangs pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya ba chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ gzhi'i zag bcas thams cad spangs pa'i 'gog pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'dir gzhi zhes pa grangs kyi bzhi la byed pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i khams de khams gsum gyi nang du 'dren mi 'dren gnyis ste brtagabazhi pa ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu bzod shes rnams kyis/ /yid 'byung gang gis spong 'gyur ba/ /kun gyis 'dod chags bral bar 'gyur/ /de ltar na ni mu bzhi srid/ /ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ spang bya gang la lam gang gis yid 'byung skyed cing spong ba yod de/ sdug bsngal bden pa la chos bzod dang chos shes dang*/ rgyu kun 'byung la rjes bzod dang rjes shes rnams kyis 'khor ba la yid 'byung skyed par byed cing ngo skal gyi sgrib pa spong bar 'gyur ba kun gyis 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

de ltar na mngon rtogs de la yid 'byung zhing nyon mongs mi spong ba dang*/ de las bzlog pa dang gnyis ka yin dang min pa'i mu ni bzhi srid de/ sdug kun la dmigs pa'i shes pa bzhi ni yid 'byung ba'i lam yin la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam ma yin/ sdug kun gyi bzod pa bzhi ni gnyis ka yin/ 'gog lam gyi bzod pa bzhi ni chags bral gyi lam yin la/ yid 'byung ba'i lam ma yin/ 'gog lam gyi shes pa bzhi ni gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu yin pa'i phyir/ gnas drug pa bshad zin to/ /bkra shis/ dge'o// //
